name: VantaAI
summary: VantaAI is an image-based abuse and deepfake detection platform that combines computer vision and NLP pipelines for media ingestion and classification. The system exposes scalable REST APIs and uses optimized inference pipelines that improved end-to-end latency by approximately 30%. Recognized at a hackathon.
motivation: Built to explore how protective AI systems can reduce online harm — focused on digital dignity, ethical AI, and proactive detection rather than after-the-fact moderation.
architecture: Computer-vision and NLP classification pipelines behind a FastAPI-style REST layer, with optimized inference paths and modular ingestion services.
outcomes: Approximately 30% latency reduction across the inference pipeline; hackathon recognition.

name: DelAI
summary: DelAI is a route optimization system built on weighted graph modeling and shortest-path algorithms. By tuning the constraint model and routing heuristics, the system achieved roughly 20% improvement in route efficiency over baseline approaches. Hackathon-winning project.
motivation: An applied take on graph theory and combinatorial optimization — exploring how classical algorithms can be retuned to make a measurable difference in real logistics scenarios.
architecture: Weighted-graph modeling layer, shortest-path engine, and a routing heuristic optimized against a multi-objective cost function.

name: fAImer
summary: fAImer is a smart farming assistant that brings ML-based crop disease detection, expense tracking, and market insights to small farmers. It is multilingual and supports offline-first usage, addressing real connectivity constraints in rural settings.
motivation: Designed around accessible technology and practical AI — making image classification and farm-management tooling usable in low-connectivity contexts and multiple languages.
architecture: ML image-classification model for crop disease detection, plus expense-tracking and market-insight modules, packaged with offline-first sync and multilingual UI.
outcomes: Working offline-first prototype with multilingual UI and crop-disease classification.

name: LawGorithm
summary: LawGorithm is a scam-detection and risk-analysis platform that uses NLP-based classification and algorithmic risk scoring to surface safety alerts. The system is exposed via REST APIs, making it embeddable into other safety-focused workflows.
motivation: Building toward digital trust and online safety — examining how NLP and risk-analysis algorithms can give people better signals about what they're reading and engaging with.
architecture: NLP-based scam classification pipeline, algorithmic risk scoring, alerting layer, and a REST API surface.
outcomes: Working NLP detection + risk-analysis pipeline with REST API.

name: StudyBee
summary: StudyBee is an AI study assistant that generates structured notes, quizzes, and formula sheets from source material. It organizes academic content algorithmically and, in internal use, reduced preparation time by approximately 40%.
motivation: Built to reduce overwhelm in academic preparation — turning unstructured course material into structured, navigable artifacts.
architecture: Content-ingestion + structuring pipeline that produces notes, quizzes, and formula sheets via algorithmic organization.
outcomes: Approximately 40% prep-time reduction in measured internal use.

name: NeuroBridge
tagline: adaptive support platform for neurodivergent users
summary: NeuroBridge is an evolving adaptive-support platform for neurodivergent individuals, with modular accessibility tools across ASD and ADHD support: a Routine Visualizer, Sensory Regulation, Social Story Builder, Emotional Check-in, Focus Sessions, and Visual Timelines. The platform takes an accessibility-first, emotionally aware approach to UX and is still architecturally evolving — not a fully deployed or medically certified product.
motivation: Centered on humane technology and cognitive accessibility — exploring how interfaces and modular tools can offer structured support without becoming gamified or extractive.
architecture: Modular feature surface (routine, sensory, social, emotional, focus, timeline) with dynamic feature activation. Designed around emotional safety and accessibility-first interaction patterns.
outcomes: Active, evolving platform with significant architectural direction; not deployed at scale or medically certified.
